novelty_flags.label: Theorem 2 gap and project_justification.gap
novelty_flags.one_line: They describe NabiGuoLiu2026 as supplying only partial multiple-constraint geometry for the G2 efficiency result, but Appendix S4.2 explicitly completes the tangent-space reverse direction for the sequential two-Verma graph and states the resulting efficient projection.

soundness_flags.label: Symbol Phi_nu and all plug-in uses of Phi_nu
soundness_flags.one_line: Phi_nu is declared for any dominated Q, although E_Q(Y|M=m,W=w) is not defined on policy-supported treatment values when nu is not absolutely continuous with respect to Q(M|W); restrict its domain to overlap laws or specify a canonical extension.

soundness_flags.label: Definitions of B_P and C_LFF_s; lemma:evans-recovery
soundness_flags.one_line: H^s(O) is used while O may contain finite-alphabet factors, but no mixed/discrete Sobolev convention is defined; consequently the asserted finite-alphabet embedding into the Sobolev class is not presently a defined mathematical claim.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 2 and Theorem 3 causal target
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Causal identification is conditional on a latent-DAG law with latent projection G2 and on modular replacement of M by the fixed policy nu.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The stated efficiency and inference claims are for Psi_nu conditional on that causal latent-variable/intervention model, not for arbitrary observed laws.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Proposition 3 gives only a general orthocomplement inclusion and Remark 5 conjectures general completeness; Appendix S4.2 treats the sequential two-Verma graph, constructs the second-order perturbation h, and says it completes the reverse-direction/tangent-space proof before describing the efficient projection.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 12, Theorem 2 and Lemma 3; p. 23, Lemma 11
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 2 makes mb-shielded equality constraints ordinary conditional independences, Lemma 3 gives the tangent decomposition, and Lemma 11 identifies a fixable-treatment mean by Markov-pillow adjustment.
Theorem 3 concerns a semiparametric Markov model defined by a finite list of ordinary conditional-independence restrictions and derives the corresponding tangent-space orthocomplement construction.
The published article studies semiparametric efficiency bounds for conditional-moment restrictions with different conditioning variables and an iterative efficient-score approximation.
The paper studies the generalized Friedrichs-angle parameter for several closed subspaces and convergence behavior of cyclic alternating projections.
